title: Zip files
prerequisites: Open File Explorer and select the files you want to zip.
concept: A ZIP file packs several files into one smaller file that's easy to email or share.

speech.demonstrate: Right-click one of the files you selected. A menu will open.
speech.hint: Which mouse button shows more options?

steps.explain: Right-clicking opens a menu of actions for whatever you clicked.

speech.demonstrate: Choose Compress to… in the menu.
speech.hint: Look for the option about making files smaller.

steps.explain: Compressing packs files into one smaller archive that's easy to share.

speech.demonstrate: Click ZIP File. Windows makes the archive right next to your files.
speech.hint: Which format is the common one?

steps.explain: ZIP works everywhere — any computer can open it without extra software.
